format: RFC6902 operations in patch; no generated OpenAPI/client written

patch.value: O-01 narrow discovery exception: registered students with NO ever membership only, newest registered_at DESC then student_id DESC. Teacher must have current own-group manage_roster grant; Owner/Admin require roster capability and target group scope. Required group_id supplies authorization context. Cursor binds actor, authority revision, group, filters and initial high-watermark; tamper/stale scope400 INVALID_CURSOR after auth. Eligibility/scope before count/page. Only StudentCandidate fields; rate limited and audited. This is not a global pupil directory.

Registered students with no current active group, including returned/inactive students, may reappear with their immutable original registered_at. Re-entry, login, removal and re-add never set a new registration date. Eligibility before count/search/page: registration_complete, active_group_id=null and an inactive membership anchor. Required group_id supplies current authorization context. Teacher discovery requires current own-group manage_roster authority and only never-placed or same-affinity inactive candidates. Admin/Owner discovery stays within current roster/read scope; cross-affinity candidates require privileged transfer, never direct member re-add. StudentCandidate fields only, no contact/Telegram/history disclosure. Sort registered_at DESC, student_id DESC. Cursor binds current actor/authority/group/filters and reviewed listing watermark; roster eligibility-change invalidation or as-of snapshot mechanics require review. Fresh listing shows a returnee in its original chronological position. Missing original dates are not invented from login.

Scope before search/count/page: Admin all-group read confirmed; Teacher own-group students/results and approved-subject content-wide demos. Pending applicants denied. Request visibility requester/authorized approver only; no client role trust. Exact qadam_id optional filter inside existing authorized directory; no global expansion. Initial candidates use /admin/students/unassigned or /lookup.

Current server scope precedes search/count/page. Teacher reads own currently assigned group roster; read visibility is not a membership mutation or transfer capability. Existing Admin/Owner directory rights remain. Exact qadam_id filter never expands the authorized directory. Unassigned/returned candidate discovery uses the separate context-bound route. Pending/unapproved/revoked actors remain denied; receipts/cursors cannot bypass current scope.

O-01 exact ten-digit Qadam ID lookup for target group placement. Teacher current own-group manage_roster required; disclose only never-placed registered pupil or inactive pupil with same retained affinity. Wrong ID, other affinity, foreign current group or nonexistent pupil all404 NOT_FOUND with same envelope/timing class; never include that group/history/contact. Owner/Admin need source+target roster scope before any disclosure. No partial-ID or broad name search. Lookup grants no placement authority; mutation rechecks under locks.

Exact Qadam candidate lookup is context-bound and does not grant authority. For a Teacher with current own-group manage_roster authority, eligible registered candidates are never-placed or inactive with affinity equal to the authorized target group. For Admin/Owner, existing directory/roster scope applies. A different affinity must use the privileged transfer route; no cross-group direct re-add, even when a Teacher controls both groups. Preserve original registered_at. Unauthorized existence stays hidden and only StudentCandidate fields are disclosed.

O-01. Only Owner or delegated Admin with manage_roster and current source/target group scope. Atomic transfer from current group or retained affinity when inactive. Same target as affinity is not a transfer (409 MEMBERSHIP_STATE_CONFLICT); use member route to re-add. Check current membership CAS after auth/privacy; only a started current in_progress attempt with locked now < deadline blocks transfer. At/after deadline materialize completion first. Unstarted approved ready recovery, including a future opens_at, never blocks transfer and is revoked atomically on successful transfer, retaining its historical window and existing attempts/answers. Commit changes affinity+membership epoch, revokes ALL old unstarted grants, keeps result/attempt history and global normal-demo usage; re-add cannot restore old access. Fresh grants require explicit authorization bound to new epoch. See x-membership-rules. No previous affinity is initial placement, not transfer:409 MEMBERSHIP_STATE_CONFLICT; use member route. The latest user decision confirms the transfer active-only guard and cancellation of unstarted recovery eligibility; exact delegation/storage/concurrency mechanics remain local review design. Removal policy is separate.

Privileged transfer remains Owner or delegated Admin with manage_roster and current source AND target group scope. Teacher cannot execute transfer even with manage_roster and both-group assignments. Owner general authority is preserved; Admin-only here distinguishes Admin from Teacher, not removal of Owner rights. Reauthorize before state and receipt replay; membership CAS and person locks remain. Only a started current in_progress attempt with locked now < deadline blocks. At/after deadline materialize existing completion before the transfer decision. Unstarted ready recovery, including future opens_at, does not block and is revoked atomically. Preserve attempts, answers, original deadline, history, registered_at and normal-demo usage; no statistical bonus change. Same-affinity re-add uses member route; cross-affinity writes cannot masquerade as re-add.
Minimal roster candidate. No Telegram identity/contact, credentials, other group, results, roles or membership history. Eligibility checked before disclosure; not a grant.

Minimal scoped roster candidate, now including eligible returned/inactive registered students. Existing required registered_at means the immutable original registration date; do not replace it with latest login/removal/re-add time. Identity/contact/history/roles/results are not disclosed. Eligibility/scope precede disclosure and this object is not an authorization grant.
